#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
vector<long long> factorials;

long long quickPower(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1LL;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

long long combination(int n, int m) {
    if (m == 0 || m == n) return 1LL;
    if (m > n || m < 0) return 0LL;
    long long numerator = factorials[n];
    long long denominator = (factorials[m] * factorials[n - m]) % MOD;
    long long invDenominator = quickPower(denominator, MOD - 2);
    return (numerator * invDenominator) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long kLong;
    cin >> n >> kLong;

    factorials.resize(n + 1);
    factorials[0] = 1LL;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }

    if (kLong == 0) {
        cout << factorials[n] << "\n";
    } else if (kLong >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        int k = (int) kLong;
        long long total = 0LL;
        long long sign = 1LL;
        int l = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
            long long term = (quickPower(l - i, n) * combination(l, l - i)) % MOD;
            if (sign == -1LL) {
                total = (total - term + MOD) % MOD;
            } else {
                total = (total + term) % MOD;
            }
            sign *= -1LL;
        }
        long long result = (2LL * combination(n, k) * total) % MOD;
        cout << result << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
